description: Restores a snapshot to its Cognigy.AI project, replacing the current configuration. DESTRUCTIVE: Current project state will be overwritten with the snapshot's state. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Async operation.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without restoring. Set to false to actually restore. WARNING: This replaces the current project configuration!

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 3)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for restore (5-600 seconds, default 180)

name: restore_snapshot
